verdict.rationale: The pack only shows a narrow 'Compliance API' for enterprise usage data (claude-docs-11/26/44) and MCP connector-building docs, but no evidence of Anthropic's general-purpose developer/Messages API for driving Claude programmatically, and probes for an OpenAPI spec returned 404s (claude-probe-3). Missing for 10: documented general-purpose public API (e.g., messages/completions endpoint) for building on Claude, working OpenAPI/API reference discovery, and independent corroboration of API usage.
